name: Echizen (Japan, town)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Echizen town emblem in green and navy: a green curved stroke above a navy stylised swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Echizen, a town in Fukui Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 February 2005.

features.role: Echizen town emblem — a green curved stroke above a navy stylised swirl
